text.en: Describe a hardware or software project you built. What problem did it solve and what was your role?
text.fil: Ilarawan ang isang hardware o software project na ginawa mo. Anong problema ang nilutas nito at ano ang naging papel mo?

criteria.name: Technical depth
criteria.description: Explains the technology used and why, with correct terms.
key_points: names the hardware or software components
explains why those components were chosen

5: We built a smart water meter. I programmed an ESP32 to read a flow sensor through interrupts, sent data over MQTT to a Raspberry Pi, and stored it in SQLite. The hard part was sensor noise, which I fixed with a moving average filter.
3: We made a water monitoring system with Arduino and sensors that sends data to a website.
1: We made a system for water. It works with a microcontroller.

criteria.correction: Name the main components you used, why you chose them, and one technical problem you solved.

criteria.name: Own role and result
criteria.description: Clearly states their personal role and the outcome.

5: I was responsible for the firmware and the data pipeline. The final system measured flow within five percent of the reference meter and was used in our dormitory for a month.
3: I did the programming part and the project passed.
1: We all worked on it together.

criteria.correction: Say exactly which part you built and what the project achieved, ideally with a number.

text.en: How do you approach debugging a program or circuit that is not working?
text.fil: Paano mo hinaharap ang pag-debug ng isang program o circuit na hindi gumagana?

criteria.name: Systematic method
criteria.description: Describes a step-by-step process: reproduce, isolate, test, fix, verify.
key_points: isolates the cause step by step

5: First I reproduce the bug reliably. Then I isolate it by testing one module at a time, using serial prints or a logic analyzer. After fixing it, I retest the whole system to make sure nothing else broke.
3: I check the code for errors and try to change things until it works.
1: I ask my classmates or search online for the answer.

criteria.correction: Describe your steps in order: reproduce the problem, narrow down the cause, fix it, then test again.

criteria.name: Tools and example
criteria.description: Names real debugging tools and gives a concrete example.

5: For example, our I2C display froze randomly. With an oscilloscope I saw the pull-up resistors were too weak, so I replaced them with 4.7 kilo-ohm resistors and it worked.
3: I use the serial monitor and a multimeter.
1: I just look at it carefully.

criteria.correction: Mention the tools you use and give one real example of a bug you found.
